## Scansion (9.109)

Hand-scanned: ἀλ-λὰ τά | γ’ἄσ παρ | τα καὶ ἀ | νή ρο τα | πάν τα φύ | ον ται. Foot 3 needs a long at τα (final short of ἄσπαρτα, no position: κ follows) and καὶ shortened before ἀ-. Irregularity is real; unit 2's note carries exactly one sentence saying so, with both places. No other flagged line.

## Considered and refused

- 9.175–176 wording vs shipped 6.120 (odyssey-028: l "hospitable", i "kind to strangers"): kept "guest-loving"/"hospitable" of the table (φιλόξεινος row; "kind to strangers" is explicitly avoided there, and the 8.575–576 row already made the same choice). Unit 38 differs from 6.120 anyway at 175 (ἤ vs ἦ; indirect, not direct question), so no whole-unit identity is required. Flag for the pipeline owner: the shipped 6.120 i still says "kind to strangers".
- 9.164 "run out **on** the ships" (i) vs l "from the ships": both readings of νηῶν; English "on" is compatible. Left.
- 9.127–129 i "to serve every purpose … to visit one another": paraphrase of τελέοιεν ἕκαστα / ἐπ’ ἀλλήλους, rebuilt from the grammar, not a remembered phrase; note explains ἕκαστα. Left.
- 9.133 i drops μάλα ("would never fail"): the wording is table-fixed for ἄφθιτοι ἄμπελοι. Left.
- 9.167 i "their smoke": αὐτῶν belongs to φθογγήν; the phrase is ambiguous in Greek order and English reads acceptably. Left.
- 9.105 note "perfect participle of ἀχέω": identical to the shipped 039 note (glossary consistency). Left. ἱκόμεθ’ "no augment": indeterminate for ι-; left.
- 9.165 unit split at the archive's mid-line full stop with an explanatory note in both units: follows the archive and the segmentation rule. Left.
- Quotation marks: outer speech (opened “ at 9.2 in 039) has no marks here, correct; ‘ on 172 with `mark`, ’ on 176, none closed at 192. Matches 017. `p` on 105, 116, 152, 161, 172, 177 all correct.
- Stock epithets (aegis-bearing Zeus, early-born/rose-fingered Dawn, grey sea, trusty companions, well-benched, heavenly Dawn, immortal gods, high mountains, monstrous) checked at every occurrence in both layers.

## Considered and refused

- 9.175–176 "guest-loving"/"hospitable" vs shipped 6.120 (l "hospitable", i "kind to strangers"): pass 1's refusal stands (table row φιλόξεινος and the 8.575 row fix the wording); still flagged for the pipeline owner.
- 9.171 i omits τότε ("and then"): resumptive after ἦμος, harmless in prose; l keeps "then".
- 9.105 ἀκαχήμενοι "perfect participle of ἀχέω": matches the shipped note and the shared entry (LSJ lists ἀχέω/ἀκαχίζω). ἱκόμεθ’ "no augment": indeterminate for ἱ-, left as in pass 1 (the note claim is the same as in 039).
- 9.126–129 i "to serve every purpose … to visit one another": kept (rebuilt from the grammar; l literal).
- 9.164 i "from the Cicones" kept though l now "of the Cicones": deliberate, explained in the note; only alternative was moving Κικόνων into unit 33's English, which would put a word in a unit whose Greek lacks it.
- 9.109 metre: re-scanned (ἀλ-λὰ τά | γ’ἄσ παρ | τα καὶ ἀ | νή ρο τα | πάν τα φύ | ον ται): third foot needs long τα and shortened καὶ, as the note says; one sentence only.
- Quotation marks re-checked: no marks on the outer speech (opened “ at 9.2 in 039, not closed here); ‘ on 172 (mark present) and ’ at the end of 176 in both l and i; ¶ on 105, 116, 152, 161, 172, 177 only.
